error_events.evidence: db_agent({"instruction": "Find all reservations for flight HAT045 and Gold members."}) carries no user id and no reservation id, and asks for a lookup by flight number and membership tier that none of the database tools supports — the db_agent says so verbatim at step 5: 'None of the available functions can directly search for reservations by flight number or membership status.' The customer had just declined at step 3 ('I don't have my reservation ID on me right now'), and the planner's work method is to 'gather identifying details (user id, reservation id) via respond_to_user' first; it asked for the id once at step 2 and never again. The delegation converts an unanswered identification question into an impossible database task.

transfer_to_human_agents({"summary": "The user is requesting to find all reservations for flight HAT045 and Gold members. The available tools do not support this query..."}) is fired on the db_agent's own initiative. The customer never asked for a human agent — her only turns (steps 1 and 3) ask the agent to look into delayed flight HAT045 and say 'Can you look up my flight HAT045 and see what's going on?' — and the transfer tool is reserved for requests that cannot be handled with the available actions or that the user explicitly escalates. The db_agent's brief is to 'Report back exactly what the tools returned ... and clearly state anything that failed or was not found'; the correct report was that no tool can search by flight number and that a user id is required. The transfer result is what ends the episode at step 7 with the delay complaint and any compensation unaddressed.
